Hi Sara — sorry you're hitting that. I just checked the event in my calendar and it shows Ben as the organizer (he forwarded from his mailbox when scheduling). There's a known edge case where forwarded invites strip the originating organizer alias and the Google event ends up with a delegated owner that blocks some SSO flows.

Quick plan: Ben, can you re-issue the invite but choose "Send as Organizer" (not forward)? If that's not possible right away, Logan can spin up a temporary Zoom bridge for Tuesday at 11am PT and we'll update the invite with the new join link so no one gets blocked. Monica, can you confirm we have a Zoom host licensed for corporate accounts?

Vanessa
